title: Predicting worsening visual field via masked dual stage attention recurrent neural network.
summary: A masked dual-stage attention recurrent neural network predicted future visual fields in glaucoma from 154,105 examinations, with severity-specific held-out comparisons against observed values.

evidence.tested: Held-out visual-field error metrics were reported across glaucoma severity groups; the retrospective evaluation does not establish prospective clinical benefit or deployment robustness.
